sentences.text:
Author: B.Krishna Mohan
Bench: B.Krishna Mohan
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice B.Krishna Mohan
 Criminal Petition No.2715 of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/A.1 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C, seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.281 of 2020, dated 18.06.2020 before Dachepalli Police Station, Gumtur District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328, 420 and 270 of the Indian Penal Code, 1806 (for short 'IPC) and Sections 56,57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and standards (for short FSS) Act, 2006.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.

Both the learned counsels submitted that the present criminal petition is squarely covered by the order dated 16.03.2020 passed by a learned Singe Judge of this Court in Crl.P.No.1439 of 2020 and batch.

Following the decision of this Court in the aforementioned criminal petition and batch, and for the reasons recorded therein, the Criminal Petition is allowed by quashing the proceedings in FIR No.281 of 2020, dated 18.06.2020 before Dachepalli Police Station, Guntur District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328, 420 and 270 of IPC and Sections 56,57(1) and 63 of FSS Act.
Registry is directed to annex copy of the order dated 16.03.2020 in Crl.P.No. 1439 of 2020 and batch.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.

B.KRISHNA MOHAN, J Dated 22.07.2020 KA THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE B.KRISHNA MOHAN CRIMINAL PETITION NO.2715 of 2020 Dated 22.07.2020 KA Murthy Putakgani vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 22 July, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25001692/
